lines.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
Yesterday I played football with my friends.
She runs in the park every morning.
Swimming is better than running for my back.
Our team won the match last night.
I want to get stronger, so I lift weights.
You should stretch before you exercise.
He is training for a race next month.
Drink water, because the weather is hot today.
Exercise makes me happy and full of energy.
